title: Heapify (Build a Heap in O(n))
summary: Turn any array into a min-heap in place by sifting down every parent, starting from the last one and working back to the root. It is faster than inserting values one by one because most nodes are near the bottom and barely move.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Array values
inputs.note: The array is read as a complete binary tree: index i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2.

anchors.label: Pick the next parent, from the last one back to the root
Assume the parent is the smallest
